summary: Parquet-partitioned delta feed for SIEM with tenant pseudonymization and key-rotation proof
description: Issue summary: Customer requests a time-windowed, Parquet-native SIEM export that delivers delta files partitioned by hour and tenant, with tenant-level pseudonymization and cryptographic rotation proof so FinEdge can satisfy audit requirements. Impact: FinEdge needs deterministic daily reconcilation and tamper-evidence for ingestion into their SIEM lake (Splunk/Databricks). Current CSV/flat exports are causing performance problems and force them to run expensive ETL. Environment: production us-east-1, enterprise tenant FinEdge (multi-org). Requested deliverables: Parquet schema, partitioning strategy, record-level pseudonymization design (per-tenant reversible tokenization under customer-managed KEK), rotation-proof manifest (signed checkpoints), and sample export artifacts for one 24-hour window.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer configures 'scheduled audit export' to S3 path s3://finedge-audit-exports/prod/ 2) In Console, selects daily window and tenant scope 3) Customer observes generated files in legacy CSV format and a single monolithic manifest.json 4) Customer attempts to run ingestion job into Databricks and hits performance/timeouts

expected_behavior: Platform should provide a Parquet-native delta export with: hourly-partitioned _date/hour_ folders, per-tenant pseudonymized identifiers (tokenization using customer KEK wrap), a compact manifest that includes file checksums and a signed rotation-proof checkpoint, and a sample ingestion pipeline config for Databricks/Splunk HEC.
investigation_notes: Initial triage: exporter currently has two formats: csv and newline-delimited-json. Parquet export is not enabled for scheduled exports for enterprise tenants (missing code path). S3 ACL 403 for listing was due to bucket policy denying ListBucket on prefix; PutObject succeeded because exporter used PutObjectAcl with explicit prefix grant. Hypothesis: Parquet path exists in internal prototype branch but not wired into scheduled job runner. Also need KMS integration for KEK wrapping of pseudonyms; current tokenization service stores reversible tokens in plaintext in exporter metadata (not acceptable). Confirmed related PR in platform repo enabling parquet write (PR 1123) but missing manifest signer and KEK-rotation hooks.

Long-term fix: merge PR 1123 to enable scheduled parquet exports, implement KMS-wrapped tokenization and manifest signer, and add automated rotation-proof checkpoints. Target rollout: 2026-03-25 behind feature flag.
